description: This file contains the implementation of the Coupon class within the Opencart catalog model extension for totals. It defines methods for calculating coupons, confirming, and unconfirming coupon application in the order process.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Represents the coupon total calculation and management for the OpenCart platform. Handles total adjustments, confirmation, and unconfirmation of coupon usage during checkout.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total discount provided by the coupon and adjusts the order totals accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms the application of a coupon to an order, updating coupon usage history and validity.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes the coupon application from an order, deleting usage history.
